title: CAST Agent Handoff Block
description: Typed schema for the ## Handoff key-value block that agents emit in multi-agent chains. The block is the machine-readable contract between sequential agents in an orchestrated wave. Runtime validation of this schema is performed by scripts/cast_handoff_parser.py inside the SubagentStop hook (WARN-only, never blocks).

files_changed.description: Comma-separated list of relative paths the agent wrote, edited, or deleted. Use the literal string 'none' if no files were changed.

status.description: Mirrors the agent's prose Status line. NEEDS_CONTEXT is not valid here — an agent that needs context is BLOCKED from the chain's perspective.

blockers.description: Anything that must be resolved before the chain continues. Use the literal string 'none' if there are no blockers.
examples: CI is failing on test_foo — downstream agent should not merge

agent.description: Which agent emitted this block. Optional but recommended for observability.

key_decisions.description: Non-obvious choices the next agent should know. Max 3 points; use semicolons to separate. Optional.

next_agent_needs.description: Specific commands or checks the downstream agent should run. Optional.

additionalProperties.description: Any additional free-form key: value fields the next agent needs to know.

examples.key_decisions: used importlib.util to load cast_handoff_parser.py — avoids sys.path pollution
examples.next_agent_needs: run bats tests/cast-subagent-stop-hook.bats to verify new step
